description: Department of Inland Revenue - Value added Tax Act, No. 14 of 2002
categorisation: This gazette content pertains to the specification of regulations and calculation methods for Value Added Tax on Supply of Financial Services under the Value Added Tax Act, No. 14 of 2002. It involves legal/regulatory matters including tax calculations, compliance requirements, and the exercise of statutory powers by the Commissioner General of Inland Revenue. The content focuses on establishing regulatory frameworks and compliance procedures rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
